_readme: HAND-WRITTEN every iteration by Claude (or the agent doing the build): what Claude is LOOKING FOR this version. Only put questions here that ONLY the user can answer (real GPU frame rate, phone feel, 'does X look right'). Then run: node tools/build-claude-check.mjs --version <Vnnn> --categories "<names>" . kinds: text | yesno | choice (needs choices) | number. device: any | desktop | phone | touch | gpu.
summary: V189: Omni⟐City step 1, a pure reality-address module (utils/OmniAddress.js: parse / serialize / validate, typed segments, drawers, perspectives); no UI change; design doc docs/architecture/OMNICITY_DESIGN.md

asks.question: Does the app start and look the same as V188 (boot, ribbon, compass, a panel)?
asks.why: V189 adds only a pure module nothing imports yet, so nothing should change; this is a cheap sanity check.

asks.question: Does the userCompass look right in its slot under the logo?
asks.why: Only judged in screenshots from software-rendered Chromium at six window sizes; line weight, brightness and size are taste. If it is too small, too big or touches something, say what in the message.

asks.question: Is the difference between Left, Center and Right alignment noticeable enough?
asks.why: The slot is only as wide as the top-left hand (103 px) and the globe is 44 px, so the globe moves about 26 px between Left and Center. A wider slot is one constant if you want more room.

asks.question: How does the spin speed feel (Normal = 14 s per turn)?
asks.why: Speeds are a guess: Slow 28 s, Normal 14 s, Fast 7 s. It rides the app ticker, so on a real GPU it should be smooth; I only saw it at about 1 fps in the software renderer.

asks.question: What should clicking the userCompass do? (today: it opens Admin > UI Settings > userCompass)
asks.why: It had to do something, so it opens its own settings. A compass could instead reset the camera heading to north, snap the view to look north, or open the camera idea later. Write what you want.

asks.question: On a narrow window or a phone the globe is hidden (the ribbon covers its strip). Do you want it visible there too?
asks.why: Below about 1010 px the ribbon runs under the whole bar, so there is no free strip. Showing it would mean giving the ribbon a 103 px left margin (tabs shrink) or putting the globe somewhere else. Say which you prefer in the message.

asks.question: Heading mode (the globe turns with where the camera faces): is that useful, and does the bright meridian read as north?
asks.why: Verified with real mouse drags in a desktop browser only; never with touch look-around on a phone.

asks.question: V187 carry-over: how does maximize feel on your phone, and is there any panel that still cannot be resized or maximized? Name it.
asks.why: Windows were only checked in a desktop browser at 390 px width, never with touch.

asks.question: How does the shooting-star entrance look (flight from the top right, tail, landing behind the ⟐)? If it needs a change, say what in the message.
asks.why: Only judged in screenshots from software-rendered Chromium; speed, tail length and star size are in the top of boot/OmniStarBoot.js.

asks.question: Is the ⟐ readable over the star?
asks.why: The star is dimmed and the glyph has a dark rim, but legibility depends on your display and font.

asks.question: Is there any panel that still cannot be resized or maximized? Name it.
asks.why: About every panel is covered by an automated check, but a panel I could not open (needs a special state) may be missed.

asks.question: Does maximize feel right on your phone (button size, sheet height, restore)?
asks.why: Only checked in a desktop browser at 390 px width, never with touch.

asks.question: Where is the summon button for LH / RH (dock ⚉ or ribbon Hands > Summon) and was it easy to find?
asks.why: You asked for it; I put the pair on dock icon ⚉ and each hand in the ribbon and the OmniHands panel.

asks.question: Real-GPU frame rate (fps) with the all-emoji demo store loaded and open?
asks.why: Every frame rate so far came from software rendering at about 1 fps; I cannot tell if the 1,914-emoji store or the shelf layouts are fast enough on a real GPU.

asks.question: How does the store feel on your phone (opening, paging, the exchange sheet, pinning a node)?
asks.why: The store and the Inspector block were only measured in a desktop browser with a narrow window. Add any detail in the message box.

asks.question: Is this Claude Check panel comfortable to use on your phone (no sideways scroll, buttons easy to hit)?
asks.why: It is new in V184 and was only checked at 390px in a desktop browser; the whole feedback loop depends on it being usable where you test.

asks.question: Did any ordinary node behaviour regress after V183 changed OmniNode / OmniInspector (create, select, edit, group, duplicate, delete, save and reload)?
asks.why: V183 touched the shared node and Inspector code; the automated suites pass but only a hands-on session shows a changed feel. If yes, name the action in the message.

knownIssues: The address type letters (C core, B branch, S space) and the eye symbol are PLACEHOLDERS until the owner picks glyphs; nothing in the app uses OmniAddress yet.
The userCompass was judged only in software-GL Chromium (six window sizes); never on a real GPU, a real phone or with touch.

The userCompass is free only while the ribbon starts to the right of its strip: windows narrower than about 1010 px, phones, tablets and a floated OmniNotify box hide it (it never overlaps the ribbon).
The userCompass slot is the top-left hand's width (103 px); the empty space up to the OmniNotify box (x 222) is not used.
The camera feature is only documented (docs/omniproducts/OMNICAMERA_IDEA.md); seven questions for the owner are still open.
The boot animation, the shooting star and the window resize / maximize were never judged on a real GPU, a real phone or with touch (software-GL Chromium only).
Window positions are still not saved; only sizes are. Maximized state is never saved.
Panels that only exist in a special state (for example Cell or Account panels) were checked through a forced-visible test, not by a person.
OmniReality is still the name of an OmniBrowserSpace layer and of OmniRealityGrid* code; only user-facing product text became OmniOS.
d3 loads from jsDelivr in the real app; first load on a real network was never tested.
The all-emoji store uses about 837 KB of the roughly 5 MB localStorage budget (an IndexedDB store would remove the limit).
